## Comparison Table

| Product | Price | Project limit | Retention | Export |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 120 USD | 40 projects | 7 days | CSV |
| Birch | 180 USD | 75 projects | 14 days | JSON |
| Cedar | 240 USD | 90 projects | 30 days | XML |

## Recommendation

**Best overall: Cedar**. It is the most expensive, but it offers the highest project limit, the longest retention, and a distinct export format. If cost is the main constraint, Atlas is the lowest-priced option. If you want a middle ground, Birch balances higher limits and retention at a lower price than Cedar.
